method: Each stock's production preprocess had already removed exact and verified near duplicates within the stock and against the firewall references, one source at a time. scripts.joint_family_graph read those five pass databases by table scan, joined exact keys, grouped whole MinHash bands across stocks, verified every band candidate by exact shingle Jaccard under the shared policy (10-token shingles, 128 permutations, 16 bands, threshold 0.8) and formed union-find families. All pass inputs and stock manifests were verified by hash. Nothing was admitted, removed or partitioned.

not_covered.ultrafineweb_hq: No production preprocess pass or band database; it needs one against the same firewall references before it can join the graph.
not_covered.stack_edu: Code families are repository-keyed; the partial repository/alias/dependency graph and 44 holds remain separate from this text graph.
not_covered.stack_v3: Review cohort only; the same code-graph boundary applies.
not_covered.infiwebmath_4plus: Sample only; no retained stock or pass database.

result.example: A dubiousoft.com physics-engine post appears in FineWeb-Edu as plain text and in FineMath as markdown under one URL; verified Jaccard 0.871.

reading: Cross-source duplication among these five stocks is small: every family has exactly two documents, all but 15 of them FineWeb-Edu/FineMath pairs, and together they hold 1,674,479 tokens, 0.026% of the 6.32B covered retained tokens. Cosmopedia and peS2o link to nothing. This removes no measurable supply and does not move any one-pass bound.
remaining_for_family_partition: Decide the development and final family partition rule and sizes for pretraining held-out losses, and its relation to the existing firewall references.
Run an UltraFineWeb-HQ preprocess pass under the same policy and firewall references, then rebuild the graph with it.
Join the text graph to the repository-keyed code family graph.

runtime.device: CPU; pass databases and inputs on a local HDD
